title: Union-Closed Sets Conjecture
exact_target: Must some element occur in at least half the sets of any finite union-closed family with a nonempty set?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1321 (COMB-003). CC BY 4.0.
Abigail Raz, \emph{Note on the union-closed sets conjecture}, arXiv:1704.07022v1 (2017), abstract and Section 1.
